assertion_analysis.failure_condition: the control permutes each split's labels under seed 20262018, recomputes the risk and requires recall@0.25 of the risk-ordered labels to fall inside the random band built from the same permuted labels; a scorer that reads row['label'] re-derives its order from the permutation and lands above the band. negative-control.log probe 1 records recall 0.414847/0.410138/0.600000/0.705882, inside False on all four pairs, exit 1.

if _scorer_risk read a label, permuting the labels would change the risk vector; the control fails when the recomputed vector differs, when the permutation is the identity, or when the stored risk no longer equals the risk recomputed from the row's own checks. negative-control.log probe 1 records 196/184/48/46 moved values and 229/217/40/34 published risks no longer equal, exit 1.

a status outside the four, a row giving no status, or four counts that do not sum to the axis total fails; because both the status map and the counts come from one classification, this guards the record's self-consistency and not the provenance of an answer.
